    requires nums != null

    ensures |result| == |nums|
    ensures forall i, j :: 0 <= i < j < |result| ==> 
        (sum_of_digits(result[i]) < sum_of_digits(result[j]) ||
        (sum_of_digits(result[i]) == sum_of_digits(result[j]) && index_of(result[i], nums) < index_of(result[j], nums)))

    // Helper method to calculate the sum of digits of a number
    method sum_of_digits(n: int) returns (s: int)
        requires true
        ensures s >= 0
        ensures s == sum_digits(n)

    // Helper method to find the index of an element in the original list
    method index_of(x: int, nums: seq<int>) returns (index: int)
        requires |nums| > 0
        requires x in nums
        ensures index >= 0 && index < |nums| && nums[index] == x
